summary: Slider grows to the redrawn sheet. variant="inline" puts the label and value inside a field-height bar (32/40/48, sm/md/lg) with a 2px --ui-border-strong handle, the flat --ui-bg-accent-subtle wash as the fill and the focus ring on the bar — xl, steppers, poles and the value control are typed `never` on it. origin makes a slider bipolar: the fill runs from an origin mark toward the thumb (the gradient mirrored below it), a POINTER released within one step lands on the origin (keyboard never snaps), and startLabel / endLabel draw the poles, the leaning one in --ui-text-primary. formatValue is shown in the value slot AND written to aria-valuetext; getAriaValueText still overrides the announcement only. The thumb lifts to --ui-shadow-md on hover and drag (exclusive with the focus ring by construction), the value uses tabular figures, and disabled text takes --ui-text-disabled. The value is now held internally (useControllableState), which closes the knownGap where steppers stopped after one step on an uncontrolled slider. SLIDER_SIZE and sliderThumbClass are exported for RangeSlider. --ui-border-strong on --ui-bg-accent-subtle and on --ui-bg-elevated join NONTEXT_CONTRAST_PAIRS (4.79 / 5.36 light, 3.37 / 5.67 dark). Geometry: design/paper/specs/slider.geometry.json (inline bar). No API removed; Image Edit unchanged. Paper: https://app.paper.design/file/01KZ39A2BC286MT85M658NRR4R/p-Z-0 (Component --- Slider --- Revision / Variants / Dark / API, Behaviour, Tokens, Gaps).
